## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nycflights13)
```

## Part 1: Average departure delay by airline

```{r}
delays_by_airline <- flights |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  summarise(
    n_flights = n(),
    avg_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_dep_delay))

delays_by_airline
```

Which airlines had the worst departure delays?

Airline F9 had the worst average departure delay at 20.22 minutes
